I cannot delete or modify the activity log entry. 

Under our operating policy ("Never" list), modifying or removing logs, audit trails, or records of actions taken by you or others is strictly prohibited. 

I understand the sensitivity regarding the account team viewing the previous wording, but log alterations cannot be performed. If appropriate, you could add a follow-up comment to the ticket to clarify the context or address the situation with the account team directly.
